title: Bounded development screen for dual-capacity unknown-prior recovery

scope.claim_status: development screen only; no SOTA claim is allowed

method.name: DCPR
method.fixed_components: DINOv2-B/14 and L/14 frozen CLS features; DCTPR temperature, Sinkhorn iterations, refinement steps, and support-query mix remain frozen from PAT-K-004
method.prior_estimator: average B/L support-prototype posteriors; downweight B/L disagreement with normalized Jensen-Shannon reliability; allocate unreliable mass uniformly; shrink the resulting class masses toward the uniform prior
method.selection_rule: maximize Episode-1 mean macro balanced accuracy across mild and severe regimes; ties select the smaller shrinkage

baselines: DCTPR with oracle counts as a non-deployable ceiling

development_go_no_go.mean_gain: selected DCPR exceeds the strongest non-oracle baseline by at least 1.0 percentage point on the Episode-1 mean across both regimes
development_go_no_go.regime_consistency: selected DCPR exceeds the strongest non-oracle baseline in both Episode-1 regimes
development_go_no_go.oracle_gap_closure: selected DCPR closes at least 30% of the DCTPR oracle-minus-uniform gap on the Episode-1 mean

internal_transfer_gate.mean_gain: frozen DCPR exceeds the strongest non-oracle baseline by at least 0.5 percentage points across Episodes 2-3 and both regimes
internal_transfer_gate.cell_consistency: frozen DCPR exceeds the strongest non-oracle baseline in at least 3 of 4 episode-regime cells
internal_transfer_gate.paired_stability: frozen DCPR is non-inferior to the strongest non-oracle baseline in at least 28 of 40 paired rotations

on_go: implement matched alpha-TIM and other relevant public imbalanced baselines, freeze DCPR once, then create untouched Stanford Dogs confirmation episodes
on_no_go: close DCPR without searching another prior-estimator formula and retain the DCTPR accuracy-efficiency paper
forbidden: do not use oracle counts as method input
do not add shrinkage values after reading results
do not call a CUB development result SOTA
do not access CUB or Stanford Dogs official test
